camel_example: aliyun agentcore POST /workspaces --region cn-hangzhou --clientToken 'workspace-create-20260805-001' --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'body={networkConfiguration={publicEgressEnabled=true, vpc={vSwitchIds=[vsw-bp1234567890], vpcId=vpc-bp1234567890, enabled=true}, publicIngressEnabled=true}, cmsWorkspace=my-cms-workspace, name=production-agents, agentSpace=my-agent-space, storageType=PRIVATE}' --version 2026-08-04 --force
description_en: Creates an AgentCore workspace control plane record. The server completes the state transition from Initializing to Initialized within the same transaction
description_zh: 创建 AgentCore 工作空间控制面记录。服务端在同一事务内完成 Initializing 到 Initialized 的状态转换
name: CreateWorkspace

fields.help_en: If specified, the workspace is directly bound to this AgentSpace without creating a new one. The associated CloudMonitor (CMS) workspace is determined by the server's reverse lookup result, and CmsWorkspace validation is skipped. When the workspace is deleted, only the binding is removed, and the AgentSpace is not deleted. The value must match the current account and region, and the associated CMS workspace must be found through reverse lookup. Otherwise, InvalidParameter is returned
fields.help_zh: 传入后工作空间将直接绑定该 AgentSpace（不再新建），其所属的 CMS 工作空间以服务端反查结果为准，此时无需校验 CmsWorkspace。工作空间删除时仅解除绑定，不会删除该 AgentSpace。必须与当前账号和地域匹配，且反查得到所属 CMS 工作空间，否则返回 InvalidParameter
fields.name: agent_space

fields.help_en: If specified, the workspace is bound to this CloudMonitor (CMS) workspace without creating a new one. When the workspace is deleted, only the binding is removed, and the CMS workspace is not deleted. The value must match the current account and region. Otherwise, InvalidParameter is returned
fields.help_zh: 传入后工作空间将绑定该 CMS 工作空间，平台不再新建；工作空间删除时仅解除绑定，不会删除该 CMS 工作空间。必须与当前账号和地域匹配，否则返回 InvalidParameter
fields.name: cms_workspace

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow public outbound access from the platform. If not specified, the default value is true. This setting only controls whether the latest versions of managed and custom agents use the public outbound endpoint of the platform. It does not affect fixed historical versions, model or Model Context Protocol (MCP) proxy outbound endpoints, or the public outbound endpoint of the user VPC
fields.help_zh: 未传时默认开启。仅控制托管及自定义 Agent 最新版本使用平台公网出口；不控制固定历史版本、模型/MCP 代理出口和用户 VPC 自身公网出口
fields.name: public_egress_enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow public inbound access. If not specified, the default value is true. If disabled, the public inbound endpoints of all agent endpoints in the workspace are closed. If re-enabled, the original public inbound endpoints are restored. INNER_DIRECT and user VPC inbound endpoints are not affected. Collaboration and Element Web inbound endpoints are not controlled by this setting
fields.help_zh: 未传时默认开启。关闭后工作空间内所有 Agent Endpoint 的公网入口关闭，重新开启后恢复原公网入口；INNER_DIRECT 和用户 VPC 入口不受影响，协作及 Element Web 入口不在控制范围内
fields.name: public_ingress_enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the VPC network
fields.help_zh: 是否开启 VPC 网络
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs. If the VPC network is enabled, at least one vSwitch must be included, and all vSwitches must belong to the VPC specified by VpcId
fields.help_zh: 交换机 ID 列表，开启 VPC 网络时至少包含一个交换机，且所有交换机必须属于 VpcId 指定的 VPC
fields.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en: The ID of the user VPC
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The VPC network configuration of the user
fields.help_zh: 用户 VPC 网络配置
fields.name: vpc

fields.help_en: The network configuration of the workspace
fields.name: network_configuration

fields.help_en: The storage type of the workspace. PLATFORM indicates platform-managed storage. PRIVATE indicates user-owned private Object Storage Service (OSS) storage
fields.help_zh: 工作空间存储类型。PLATFORM 表示平台托管存储，PRIVATE 表示用户私有 OSS 存储
fields.name: storage_type

publicEgressEnabled.description_en: Returns the target configuration value. Updating indicates that the change is still in progress, and UpdateFailed indicates that the current change failed. This parameter only controls whether the latest versions of managed and custom agents use the public egress of the platform. It does not control fixed historical versions, model or MCP proxy egress, or the public egress of the user VPC
publicEgressEnabled.description_zh: 返回配置目标值；Updating 表示变更仍在执行，UpdateFailed 表示本轮变更失败。仅控制托管及自定义 Agent 最新版本使用平台公网出口；不控制固定历史版本、模型/MCP 代理出口和用户 VPC 自身公网出口

publicIngressEnabled.description_en: Returns the target configuration value. Updating indicates that the change is in progress, and UpdateFailed indicates that the change failed. If disabled, the public ingress for all agent endpoints in the workspace is closed, and the original public ingress is restored when re-enabled. INNER_DIRECT and user VPC ingress are not affected. Collaboration and Element Web ingress are not controlled by this parameter
